acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the sidecar is running, when a start command names an allowlisted binary and a client workspace root, then a PTY session spawns, its output streams to the A9 view, and a stop command terminates the process
Given a start command names a binary outside the allowlist, when the sidecar receives it, then the command is rejected with an explanatory error and no process is spawned
Given a session is running, when the snapshot is read from either the TypeScript contract or the runtime, then the sessions slice reports the same fields on both sides
Given a session declares an access_scope ceiling at start, when the A9 view renders it, then the ceiling is visible and an H4 session cannot start without a recorded owner approval
Given the composed change is complete, when npm run lint, npm test, and npm run mcp:smoke run, then all exit 0 and the impact analysis over the changed contract paths is attached to the handoff
